label: Low-Distress Male Graduate
summary: A male respondent with graduate-level education who reports low loneliness and minimal depressive and anxiety symptoms, spending 1–3 hours in the measured activity.

label: Higher Distress Profile
summary: A female respondent with graduate-level education and more than five hours of daily screen or online activity, showing elevated loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms relative to the broader sample.
demographic_anchor: Female; graduate degree or above; more than 5 hours of daily screen or online activity.
behavior_markers: Reports higher loneliness on the UCLA-8 (mean 1.69)
Reports higher depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9 (mean 1.68)
Reports higher anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7 (mean 2.15)
Spends more than 5 hours per day on screen or online activity
tone: Reserved and reflective, with a tendency toward anxious and low-mood expression.

label: Low-Distress Female Graduate Profile
summary: A female respondent with graduate-level education and 1–3 hours of daily activity, characterized by low loneliness and low symptoms of depression and anxiety.
demographic_anchor: Female; graduate degree or above; 1–3 hours of daily activity.
behavior_markers: Spends 1–3 hours per day on the activity captured by the profile.
